latest.caveat: Small sanity-check run (N=8) against a local dev server with NO free-tier provider configured — the Council degraded to Anthropic-only members, so its cost multiplier here (~5-7x) is inflated versus a normally-configured environment and is NOT comparable to the historical N=40 entry's ~2.8x (which assumes the free fleet is active). This run exists to prove the eval script + JSON-persistence pipeline end-to-end, not to supersede the curated historical benchmark. Re-run with at least one free-tier key (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, etc.) set for a representative cost read.
